reason_for_addendum: Pinned OpenROAD 26Q2-1164 rejects ORFS GPL_RANDOM_SEED because installed global_placement lacks -random_seed. A second bounded test showed place_pins -random/-random_seed are obsolete and skipped by this binary. Both failures are archived.
physical_seed_intervention: Apply a seeded, deterministic coordinate perturbation to movable instances in one common ORFS 3_place.odb, legalize with detailed_placement, and freeze five distinct placed ODBs before scan rewiring
qualification: Treat a seed as a physical replica only if the resulting 3_place.odb differs in actual placed FF and/or other instance coordinates from every other seed, and all architectures of that design and seed start from this identical database.
limitation: These are seeded perturb-and-legalize physical realizations from one global placement, not independent global-placement optimizations. Correlation among realizations must be reported; this method may be weaker than a full placer-seed experiment.
